dashboard.title: Inventory & Procurement Dashboard
dashboard.description: Track school inventory, manage stock levels, handle requisitions, and streamline procurement processes.
dashboard.metricsNote: Key inventory metrics and summaries will appear here.

warehouses.title: Warehouses / Stores Management
warehouses.description: Define and manage different warehouses or store locations within the school.
warehouses.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this warehouse? This might affect stock levels.

itemCategories.title: Inventory Item Categories Management
itemCategories.description: Define categories for inventory items (e.g., Stationery, Lab Equipment, Furniture).
itemCategories.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this item category? This may affect existing items.

items.title: Inventory Items Management
items.description: Maintain a master list of all inventory items.
items.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this item? This may affect fixed assets, stock levels, and transactions.
items.alertRequiredFields: Item Name, Unit of Measure, and Item Type are required.

fixedAssets.title: Fixed Assets Management
fixedAssets.description: Track fixed assets, including asset tags, purchase details, depreciation, and assignment to staff.
fixedAssets.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this fixed asset record?
fixedAssets.alertRequiredFields: Item and Asset Tag are required.

requisitions.title: Stock Requisitions Management
requisitions.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this requisition? This will also delete all its items.
requisitions.emptyItemsMessage: No items added to this requisition yet.
requisitions.deleteItemConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this item from the requisition?

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders (LPOs)
purchaseOrders.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this purchase order?
purchaseOrders.emptyItemsMessage: No items added to this purchase order yet.
purchaseOrders.deleteItemConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this item from the purchase order?

stockIssuance.title: Stock Issuance
stockIssuance.description: Record items issued from stores. This will update stock levels.
stockIssuance.alertRequiredFields: Item, Warehouse, valid Quantity, and Transaction Date are required.

stockLevels.title: Current Stock Levels
stockLevels.description: View current stock levels for all items across different warehouses. Use filters to narrow down the list.
stockLevels.emptyStateMessage: No stock levels found for the current filter.

procurementDashboard.title: Procurement Overview
procurementDashboard.noContractsForRenewal: No contracts due for renewal soon.
